name: smwmusic-torpedo
title: Torpedo
description:
The winning Original entry from Super Famicompo 4, now finally here! Go rocketing on this Torpedo to whatever mysterious places it dares to take you, be that the mysterious depths of the ocean, the expanses of the galaxy, or the boundless digital cyberspace.

Contains an option to toggle between a shorter version that only loops the main section and the full version as heard in the contest.

Incompatible with Thunder.
